statements: I agree to local H6 collection of provider-supplied recording duration, playback context (including playlist names if supplied), ordered sessions, and optional contextual follow-up answers.
Skipping and non-skipping do not establish preference or psychological function. No psychological classification is generated during collection.
My two neutral answers are locked before optional follow-ups; at most two follow-ups are offered. Approximate musical positions are optional participant reports, not measured exposure.

Sharing H6 follow-up evidence, extended event/session evidence, and playlist context are separate choices. Only selected sections enter the full export preview; exporting requires a final explicit confirmation.
After transfer, local deletion cannot remove researcher-held copies or backups. Contact the researcher for withdrawal; backup retention and already disseminated anonymous results may limit deletion.
